features.name: log_capital_total
features.description: Log-transformed total number of capital letters to compress the long tail and provide a smooth continuous feature for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in capital letter counts, allowing the SVM to learn a more stable weight.

features.name: log_capital_longest
features.description: Log-transformed length of the longest continuous sequence of capital letters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized severity measure of capitalization bursts, which is highly informative for linear decision boundaries.

features.name: capital_burstiness
features.description: Ratio of the longest capital run to the average capital run, clipped to a maximum of 50.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative extremity of capitalization within the text, providing a scale-invariant feature useful for linear models.

features.name: total_special_chars_log
features.description: Log-transformed sum of all special character frequencies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse character frequencies into a single dense, smooth feature that linear models can easily weight.
features.formula: np.log1p(char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5)

features.name: char_freq_3_dominance
features.description: The proportion of special character frequency 3 relative to all special characters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded [0,1] ratio that isolates the specific impact of one highly variable character frequency against the overall character usage.
features.formula: char_freq_3 / np.maximum(char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5, 0.01)

features.name: frequent_words_sum_log
features.description: Log-transformed sum of several high-frequency words to create a dense composite feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines multiple correlated high-frequency word features into a single smooth projection, reducing collinearity issues in linear SVMs.

features.name: rare_words_sum_log
features.description: Log-transformed sum of several low-frequency words.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse signals from rare words into a continuous measure, improving the margin separation for edge cases.

features.name: word_freq_18_26_diff
features.description: Absolute difference between two highly variable word frequencies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the divergence between two common vocabulary terms, providing an interaction-like effect in a linear space.

features.name: char_freq_4_scaled
features.description: Scaled and clipped version of character frequency 4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounds the feature strictly between 0 and 1, which is ideal for SVM regularization and margin stability.

features.name: capital_run_length_average_scaled
features.description: Scaled and clipped version of the average capital run length.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents extreme average run lengths from dominating the linear gradient updates by capping and scaling the value.

features.name: semantic_urgency_score
features.description: A semantic assessment of the text's urgency or call-to-action intensity, based on the underlying vocabulary and punctuation patterns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a high-level continuous severity measure of urgency that linear models can use as a strong primary axis for separation.

features.name: semantic_commercial_intent
features.description: A semantic assessment of the likelihood that the text contains commercial, promotional, or transactional intent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Distills complex vocabulary interactions into a single linear projection representing commercial nature, directly aiding the SVM margin.
